evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus (1861), index s.v. München: Monachium
terms.comment: A town takes no preposition: Monachium (to), Monachiī (in, at), Monachiō (from).

monachium.html: Morgan–Owens and Graesse print the city’s name without quantities; nothing in our sources gives its i a long vowel.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio, geographical section, with the authorities it cites (cited as M-O s.v.).

J. G. Th. Graesse, Orbis Latinus (Dresden, 1861), German–Latin index, read in the scan at archive.org (the 1909 edition at columbia.edu could not be reached page by page); its forms are post-classical unless Lewis & Short has them.
